title: Welcome team
commitment: One Friday a month · 40 minutes early
blurb: The first face a visitor sees. Learn names, notice who came alone, and follow up on Monday.

title: Worship team
blurb: Musicians and singers. An audition is a conversation and a run-through, not a performance.

title: Children's ministry
blurb: Teaching the 7–12s during the main service. All volunteers are checked and no adult is ever alone with a child.

title: Prayer ministry
blurb: Praying for the church week by week, and available after the service for anyone who asks.

title: Care and visitation
commitment: As needed · a few hours a month
blurb: Hospital visits, help for members between contracts, and a phone call to whoever has stopped coming.

title: Media and sound
blurb: Sound desk, slides and the recording. Training given; being good with a laptop is enough to start.
